verdict.rationale: Codex evidence describes only OpenAI's own models (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark) and access via ChatGPT plans or OpenAI API key—no mention of selecting alternative providers like Anthropic or Google within Codex itself. Community comments show users switching to entirely separate tools (Claude, Gemini) when Codex quotas run out, not choosing providers within one session.
